scope: Historical public trial outcome reanalysis; not validation of the independent Rust process model or a farmer-specific forecast
primary_comparison: Marsden 3-year system minus 2-year system, corn and soybean phases separately
reason: Oats replaced triticale starting in 2006; common coverage for existing corn and soybean records; six chronological years on each side
corn_unit: Verify author-processed dry Mg/ha against pinned raw workbook; divide by (1-0.155) to express grain at 15.5% moisture, then use 0.06277 Mg/ha per bu/ac where needed
soy_unit: Reported bu/ac at 13% moisture; retain source conversion 0.06719 Mg/ha per bu/ac
pairing: Same crop, year and replicate block, exactly one record per system after declared author subplot aggregation
management: Whole management-system contrasts, including manure/fertilizer/herbicide/tillage and subplot aggregation; not an isolated clover or rotation-sequence causal effect
historical_contrast_baselines: Predict held-out annual contrast as zero
Predict held-out annual contrast as mean paired annual difference in training years
metrics: fraction of years with positive contrast
uncertainty: Descriptive percentile bootstrap of whole years (10000 resamples, seed 7112026), averaging all four blocks before resampling. Conditional on one experiment and its four blocks, not a field prediction interval or full site-to-site uncertainty.
holdout_rule: No parameter changes or train/test ratio changes after held-out contrast scores are calculated
pfi_role: Independent published 2022 strip-trial summaries with four replicated strips per treatment; no fabricated raw replicates or p-values; original LSD and significance labels retained
water_rule: Moisture state and qualitative seasonal patterns are not ET, irrigation saving or a water balance. Sensor failures and conflicting dates remain explicit.
economics_rule: Published historic net returns retain their definition and vintage; no transfer to current farm profit. Any new break-even calculation uses explicit conditional costs and prices, separate from observed trial effects.
NASA_role: Existing POWER historical regional context may stratify descriptive weather exposure only. No exact field coordinates invented for public farms and no satellite proxy relabeled as ground truth.
human_testing: Not performed; real farmer participation unavailable in this round. Supply protocol, blank records, facilitator tool and analysis without synthetic human results.
